relationships.subject: cocaine
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that a single injection of cocaine during adolescence caused regional differences in the FGF‐2 expression pattern, with up‐regulation in the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) and nucleus accumbens (NAc) and reduction in the hippocampus

key_findings: Adolescent cocaine exposure, even a single dose, alters neuroplasticity markers in a region-specific manner, with the PFC the major target.
